text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021. May 5, 2021: Councillor Thompson, during the morning session of the meeting, acknowledged the exemplary contributions and service of Gord McEachen, Acting Chief, Toronto Paramedic Services. Councillor McKelvie, during the morning session of the meeting, congratulated the Toronto Tamil Chair and the Canadian Tamil Congress for their achievement in fulfilling their three million dollar pledge, made in 2018. The pledge will allow for a full-time Chair of Tamil studies at the University of Toronto, Scarborough. Mayor Tory addressed City Council and recognized the fundraising efforts of the Toronto Tamil community in Toronto and congratulated them for their success.
